purpose: Compare the unchanged local Qwen3:4b translation path with one publisher-supported thinking/sampling profile under the same app resource bounds.
hypothesis: Allowing the same model to reason before its final JSON response may improve actor, quantity and condition preservation. This is unproven; semantic substitution in complete short inputs establishes that chunking/JSON alone do not explain the remaining failures.
shared_contract: Same production source batching, prompts, JSON schema, source preservation and exports-independent translation function.
No reference answer, case-specific rule, glossary, name substitution or expected answer is sent to the model.
Same loopback-only transport,240-second per-call limit and unload policy.
One fixed seed; no repeated sampling or best-output selection.
No silent increase of output/context budget if thinking truncates.

evaluation.semantic_decision: Review full propositions after execution, separately from lexical flags. Do not promote or run fresh validation unless complete reviewed development materially improves with no major errors.

untouched_validation.use: Hash only; no input/output inspection or inference in this experiment.

scope: One bounded development-only profile comparison; the publisher recommends larger output budgets for general reasoning, so failure here is not a blanket claim about Qwen thinking.

primary_sources.support: Publisher supports thinking and non-thinking; recommends temperature0.6/top_p0.95/top_k20/min_p0 for thinking and warns against greedy thinking.
Ollama chat accepts think:true and separates model reasoning from final content.
Existing4B Q4_K_M local tag and public model digest prefix, Apache2.0 license.

verified_runtime.setup_owner: summary follow-up agent; runtime and cache verification completed before this translation experiment
